<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0042026-03-0410-03-55" status="unreviewed"> gzhung 'di rnams la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang nag</rs></note> na re bde' bsogs sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya ma yin
               <lb n="N009"/>te ra rig gis rab dang mi nus pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ba ni ma yin te | de ltar na don spyi <abbr>thams cad</abbr> sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya yin pa khegs par 'gyur te rang rig gis brda' gdugs mi nus pa'i phyir ro || rtog pas brda' gdags min rgyus zer na yul dang yul can bdag 1 pa'i phyogs chos ma grub par 'gyur ro || </seg></TEI>
